services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Valeria Raymond
reviews.text: Ryan spent so much time helping me understand exactly what repairs my vehicle needed and why. I’m so thankful his team was able to help me out so quickly and for a very fair price. I will absolutely be back.

reviews.author: Nancy Thompson
reviews.text: Ryan was great. We are on vacation and he jumped right on our car and fixed it in 1 day. Best mechanic . You feel he genuinely cares about your problem. Inspected everything for any other problem it may have. Great experience!

reviews.author: Zac
reviews.text: this is now my go to place for service. I received excellent service in a very timely fashion. I went in just to have my brakes replaced. They also found issues from other dealership previous work. I can not recommend Ryan and his team enough. As I said this is now my go to place for service. Top notch and if the customer service and repair work didn't seal the deal. Ryan's price was the best in town.

reviews.author: maggie mehaffey
reviews.text: Ryan always explains everything in a way that you can understand. He always does a great job and doesn’t try to price gouge his customers. I am born and raised in Haywood and know every car shop and would 100% recommend him over every other automotive shop!

reviews.author: Ginny Brenna
reviews.text: I felt I was in very good hands with Ryan, the owner and mechanic. He's "good people": friendly, professional, honest, extremely dedicated to excellence and very fair in his pricing. With his state of the art equipment he diagnosed the problem quickly, showed me the site, thoroughly explained the solution, and wasted no time solving the problem for me.

reviews.author: Catherine Topel
reviews.text: I have owned four M. Benz in my lifetime, keeping each one until it is twelve or more years old. I have used many service companies and dealers and believe the Appalachian Automotive is the best! They are skilled, personable and fairly priced. Ryan and his team are thorough and communicate very well with their customers. I love my aging diesel and will drive it until it absolutely dies or I can arrange to have one imported. I am confident Ryan and AA can keep it running! Thanks y’all!

reviews.author: terri beau
reviews.text: Ryan is great with customers al though I didn’t get my car fixed there. I don’t have the money, but he was very helpful and did find out what was wrong with it.

reviews.author: Fran Sullivan-Fahs
reviews.text: We had some trouble lights that were lighting intermittently and our single back windshield wiper had become degraded. Sierra ran the computer diagnostics and switched out the new wiper for the old one so efficiently that my husband was pleasantly shocked when minutes later she handed him the print out and showed him the new wiper was now installed. What an efficient company! Fran and Ron Fahs

reviews.author: Lori Schroeder
reviews.text: I cannot recommend this shop highly enough! After finding ourselves in a stressful situation on short notice (car trouble while on family vacation), Ryan provided the best auto service we have ever experienced. Sierra was incredibly helpful and was willing to go the extra mile to find the necessary parts for our vehicle. They were incredibly knowledgeable and took the time to provide a clear, thorough explanation of the necessary repairs without any pressure. Their prices were very reasonable, but what truly stood out was their dedication to helping us in our time of need. It is rare to find such honest, skilled, and compassionate professionals. If you need any vehicle service, Appalachian Automotive is the place to go!

reviews.author: Gilles D
reviews.text: Nothing but the best! Saved me from a disaster. Passing by for my BD and had car problems. Ryan stopped what he was doing to help me and was extremely knowledgeable. I now have a solution that will not keep me from celebrating my birthday.

reviews.author: Senator Blutarsky
reviews.text: Ryan fixed my convertible top in record time for a great price. I will definitely bring my cars to him for now on and I will highly recommend him to others.

reviews.author: Diana Deviney
reviews.text: This shop was extremely helpful. They worked hard to fit my car in for repair as I was leaving from vacation and was from out of town. The entire team was friendly, professional and efficient. Sierra went out of her way to help me find transportation while my car was being repaired and gave me a ride to the car rental office. I would highly recommend this shop for your auto repair needs.

reviews.author: Savannah Ziglar
reviews.text: The best mechanic I have ever been to, I likely will never go anywhere else! Amazing and thorough service and excellent work on my vehicle!

reviews.author: Ariel K
reviews.text: Excellent and affordable service. Wonderfully nice staff and very communicative through the whole process. What I thought would take 2-3 days only took 1!! Very happy will come back

reviews.author: Billie Newcomb
reviews.text: They did an outstanding job, were so kind to us. Diagnosed the issues and fixed it right away. Cierra went above and beyond to help us. She is very knowledgeable and was in contact with us all the way, letting us know the problems and explaning it all to us. We were so pleased with everyone and going forward will only use Appalachian Automotive for our vehicle needs. You will not go wrong in using their services.

reviews.author: Margeaux Boles
reviews.text: The best customer service experience I’ve ever had! Truly pleasant interaction from start to finish, the owner and employees are so kind and truly take time to listen and it feels like they appreciate your business (not just doing you a favor like some places make it seem). I went to three other places that said they couldn’t figure out the issue but Appalachian knew immediately what it was and got it fixed. I love their system that shows you the diagnostics as they’re checking the car (with actual photos to back it up so you know they’re not just telling you that you need unnecessary things). Very professional and knowledgeable, I feel like my car is in great hands! Highly highly recommend, I won’t go anywhere else now! Thanks so much!

reviews.author: Kim May
reviews.text: Ryan is AMAZING! Having only just purchased this car, when it began throwing warning symbols & running rough I feared the worst. He was very professional but also reassuring as he obviously has a tremendous amount of experience with foreign auto repair. Thank you God I found him. My Audi TT is purring like a kitten now.

reviews.author: Taco Powered Time Traveler
reviews.text: Fantastic automotive shop! I’ve tried other shops in town with very mixed results but getting my air conditioner compressor replaced at Appalachian Auto was easy and fast. I wasn’t expecting a phone call for another week or two when they let me know more car was ready. They are extremely professional and their mechanics are top of the class. I will always call them first.

reviews.author: Cara Green
reviews.text: Outstanding service! When our only working vehicle broke down, Appalachian Automotive went above and beyond to help. Their honesty and integrity were clear from the start. No hidden fees, no unnecessary repairs, just straightforward, expert care! The team kept us informed every step of the way. This provided us so much peace of mind. In a time when trust is hard to come by, these mechanics stand out as a beacon of professionalism and kindness. Thanks to Appalachian Automotive, what could have been a nightmare turned into a smooth, stress-free experience. If you need reliable, honest, and friendly auto service, look no further! These folks are the real deal! Thank y’all so much!!!

reviews.author: Larry Cobb
reviews.text: Ryan did an amazing job and turned my car around in a short amount of time. He worked with coverage on a third party warrantee provider. His pricing is fair, his service is excellent!

reviews.author: Nancy Benjamin
reviews.text: This auto repair shop goes out of its way to accommodate you and make sure that all of your concerns are taken care of. It's really exemplary customer service! They're very knowledgeable, reasonable, and helpful, even dropping you off back home when you leave your car with them. They have all the diagnostic equipment to correct long standing issues. The owner, Ryan, is clearly committed to his craft and very skilled. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: David Lawson
reviews.text: Ron diagnosed the problem quickly ordered the part and installed it promptly. Very satisfied with the service.

reviews.author: Doug Lynch
reviews.text: Traveling and stopped here to get some issues checked out. Took me right in and did an inspection. Told me there were a few minor issue but nothing that would not affect us in safely getting home. Beyond amazed by the honesty and customer service here. Thanks again for taking care of us.

reviews.author: Connor Cromartie
reviews.text: Honest, friendly, and trustworthy. We had an issue with our AC driving up from Florida. Found Appalachian automotive and everyone was super helpful and got our AC working quickly. Highly recommend these guys to anyone!

reviews.author: Mike Maples
reviews.text: I think reviews are ridiculous and put too much pressure on people but you have to stop to give praise where it's due. These people are the real deal. They are knowledgeable, hospitable and diligent in all they do. I feel blessed after going in there and hope the people of this area realize how rare it is to experience this quality of business in these times. Thank you again.

reviews.author: Joanne Anderson
reviews.text: I couldn't ask for a better repair shop to work on my BMW.I highly recommend them. They even brought me home and came and picked me up when my BMW was done. Thank you for going out of your way for me. I really appreciate it. Look forward to the next repair we have to do. Thank you again.

reviews.author: Garry and Christina Baxter
reviews.text: Had problem with my ABS breaking system and Ryan figured it out. Turned out to be the brand new brake calipers I installed were both defective. He also did my rear brakes and cv axles and a few other maintenance issues on my 2014 tacoma. I will definitely use them again. GB

reviews.author: Micha Belden
reviews.text: Very impressed. I just had my first experience with Ryan's team at Appalachian automotive doing a ton of work on my BMW, and now I will not be taking my cars anywhere else in WNC. The technical knowledge here is excellent, and the customer service was outstanding!

reviews.author: Roberto Lopez
reviews.text: Professional work very satisfied With the workmanship and attitude. I have been a Satisfied customer for many years.

reviews.author: Adam Reilly
reviews.text: I recently took my 1995 Toyota Camry to Appalachian Automotive for an inspection and was very impressed with their service. They provided a thorough inspection at a fair price, taking photos and videos of everything they found. They also gave me an online resource detailing all the issues with my car, breaking them down by urgency, and included progressive repair quotes so I could plan accordingly. Their transparency and professionalism made me feel confident in their work. After this experience, they’ve established themselves as my go-to mechanics. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable and honest shop. (Attaching my inspection score image for reference.)

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.text: The car wouldn’t start. It would turn over but would not start. I took it to a repair shop, and they told me I needed a new battery. I had them put in a new battery, and the car ran great. I took it to the nearest gas station and filled it with gas and it ran perfectly back home. The next day I tried to start the car and it would turn over but it would not start. I took the car to Appalachian Automotive and the mechanic there had raced Miata‘s. He said I bet it’s the negative battery cable. He was right on target, I could’ve saved myself $300 if I had gone to him in the first place. Lesson learned!

reviews.author: Angela
reviews.text: I’ve been to this automotive repair shop a few times now, and every visit has been a great experience. The staff is always friendly, attentive, and genuinely helpful. It’s clear they care about their customers and their work. Hands down the best shop in town, honest, reliable, and professional. I’ll always come back here for any car issues. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: mike david
reviews.text: Ryan and Joel have been professional and accommodating in every way. Ryan's technicians are very knowledgeable and were able to resolve all my mechanical needs. I will continue to recommend those who find the need for auto repair to Appalachian Automotive. Finally, thank you Ryan for offering a military discount. Every little bit help! Michael Davis

reviews.author: Lorinda Whaley
reviews.text: Super impressed with the service and communication! I would recommend Appalachian Automotive to anyone looking for a positive and transparent experience. We took my daughter’s Acura in for some issues. They were very quick to diagnose and the cost to fix it was reasonable.

reviews.author: Melanie Reed
reviews.text: Ryan came highly recommended. When I called him to ask about repairing my car, he was very gracious in offering his time to fix my car. He was very professional, kind and respectful. He is very knowledgeable about what he does. He replaced the valve gasket on my car, cleaned my engine and made sure I understood exactly what he was doing. I would recommend using Appalachian Automotive! Bonus...his waiting room is nice and his dogs are adorable!

reviews.author: Stacey Chuang
reviews.text: Ryan is the nicest mechanic I’ve ever met!! My car battery died on me during the Thanksgiving weekend and Ryan happened to be at the shop and helped me out. From choosing the battery I want, to switch them out for me, and to make sure everything is set before I leave. I can’t thank him more and I would recommend everyone to come here!

reviews.author: paul .creighton
reviews.text: Let me start by saying that Ryan and Cierra provided the absolute best customer service to me as a customer and their work on my 2005 Nissan xterra was top notch and I could not be happier with every aspect of their work They both kept me informed about the work being done on my vehicle and they are both extremely knowledgeable about any and all aspects of an automobile and to be honest they are the best people t that anyone would want to deal with if you need anything done to your vehicle. If you need quality work done at a good price then do not hesitate to contact them and know that you are in good hands with Appalachian Automotive

reviews.author: Edward Ritchotte
reviews.text: Had to have my front end aligned due to a close encounter with a curbstone. Service was prompt and extremely professional. The results on the alignment sheet were almost perfect, but a few readings were right on the edge of the limits due to some problems with suspension parts due to the curbstone. Ryan was very professional and courteous. I highly recommend Appalachian Automotive for service! I'm very happy that I have found a reputable service provider in this vicinity where I will be spending a lot of time.

reviews.author: Doug Bailey
reviews.text: These guys were referred to me by a friend. They had zero connection to me other than that. They were willing to work me in, fix my son’s semi-emergency, and were very professional and reasonable. Expressed some other problems my son is encountering and Ryan agreed to step up and help him out. Blown away!!! All my cars come to them from now on.

reviews.author: Noah Covell
reviews.text: I brought my 2013 Ram 2500 diesel with a bad coolant leak to Appalachian Automative and had a great experience! Owner and staff were nice and easy to work with, they diagnosed the problem and ordered the correct parts for the fix. Once the parts arrived they had my truck ready to go in less than 24 hrs. No more coolant leak!

reviews.author: Walter Austin
reviews.text: I have been using Appalachian Automotive for about 6 years and they have always been excellent. We had a critically ill family member, (died in May) that we need to go to in Atlanta ASAP. We need brake repairs identified by the dealership, but they couldn't get to us for several weeks. Ryan took our 2020 Outback in, worked over the weekend and had the car ready by Monday. Need I say more, except, "Thank You!"

reviews.author: Pat Zambri
reviews.text: They are a super professional organization. They worked with my extended warranty company for my RV. They are well respected as you can tell by the volume of vehicles being worked on I would use them again if needed

reviews.author: james pantke
reviews.text: I stopped by for a state inspection without an appointment. They were able to get me in fight away. Very friendly and fast service. I highly recommend them. No more quick oil change places for me.

reviews.author: Audrey Rose
reviews.text: I am so lucky to have found Appalachian Automotive! They are very professional and very very courteous. This place is great for high-end cars. Ryan fixed my beloved 2006 lr3 air conditioning when Land Rover wanted to charge me a small fortune. His shop is amazing in every way. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Bryan Whitfield
reviews.text: I really appreciated the care and professionalism with every interaction. Whether it be a call, a text, or in person. Ryan was very helpful and a wealth of knowledge. The courtesy inspection was unexpected but I very much appreciated it because I was able to take care of a couple other things on top of the alignment I initially wanted. They called me and asked if I wanted anything extra done while my vehicle was on the lift. I'll say that again, they called and asked, BEFORE doing the work! They were very open about everything and explained everything very thoroughly in terms that even a non-vehicle-savvy individual would comprehend. Probably hands down the best experience I've ever had getting work done on my vehicle. There is a reason these guys stay booked. They will have my business from now on, and I'll gladly recommend them to any friends and family.

reviews.author: Margaret Poore
reviews.text: Ryan is the epitome of professional. No one wishes for a car maintenance issue, but rest assured you’re in experienced hands at Appalachian Automotive. A few months ago I brought my 2015 Mini in for a brake light issue, Ryan did a quick and perfect fix. When I started experiencing shaking issues, they diagnosed the problem, showed me where the engine mount was broken and educated me on the issue. Pricing was transparent and upfront, which is so appreciated!

reviews.author: Nancy
reviews.text: The most sophisticated diagnostics. This operation is top-notch. I had an emergent situation with my 14-year-old BMW and it was taken care of with expertise. I have been worry-free since the repair. Ryan and his crew were courteous and concise, allowing me to make an informed decision on how much work had to be done. I now have a list of things that I will go back for since having the water pump and all surrounding attachments replaced. Thank you for your great service and support.

reviews.author: Eve Barrett
reviews.text: Ryan was friendly, fast, courteous and professional. The staff was professional, as well. I buzzed in late one afternoon and Ryan had my part installed the next afternoon. I love the fact that the team is prior military. The shop runs like a well-oiled machine. I felt like I was with family as I waited for Ryan to replace my runner light. Excellent service! Will return and refer all my friends!!!

reviews.author: Lori Pulverenti
reviews.text: Ryan got our van right in, diagnosed with a fuel pump problem and repaired within 24 hrs! It is huge because not only is it our transportation, it's our home while my husband is a thru-hiker on the AT. Sierra assisted in helping me find a vehicle rental and drive me to it so I could pick up my husband as planned and get to a hotel. The hike was uninterrupted, thanks to Ryan! Plus Sierra gave a great tip on where to grab a meal. Bonus, the van is in great working order and will continue to help us attain the goal of completing the trek to Maine. I highly recommend Ryan and his team!

reviews.author: Joe R
reviews.text: Appalachia’s Automotive and owner/mechanic Ryan are the best. He is really honest and seems to take great pleasure in making sure his customers really understand whatever issues their vehicle may be having. He showed me what the issue was with our vehicle and could have made a lot of money fixing it, but recommended against it. It is difficult to know what to do if you don’t know a lot about automotive so that really built my trust. It is how I treat my patients - lots of explanations and pictures, and recommend what should be done as well as what could be done, even if that means nothing. Prices are reasonable as well. He also did a great job inspecting a used vehicle I was considering and saved me from making a big mistake! Thanks Ryan!

reviews.author: Kylie Conard
reviews.text: I was incredibly impressed with Appalachian automotive. Ryan was very helpful and got my car back running quickly. He was the first of four mechanics to notice I needed a few new spark plugs and ignition coils! I would definitely recommend this shop and will be returning myself.

reviews.author: byron gale
reviews.text: My son broke down coming from a skiing trip and we are from out of state. Ryan was very accommodating in getting the repair underway. There was more damage than we anticipated, and he made a better deal out of a very bad one.

reviews.author: Amanda Collier
reviews.text: From the first phone call to inquire about service to the point I picked up my car these hard working men were professional and extremely polite. They were helpful had the right answer for all my questions and or needs. I highly recommend Appalachian Automotive for any of your car maintenance needs, it is definitely now the only place I will take my car. I grew up with both my dad's being machanics and both had their own shop. I usually know what is wrong with my car and I don't trust just anyone to work on it. These guys were awesome! Thank you so much to Ryan and Austin for communicating with me,. confirming with me before fixing anything outside of what I brought my car in for and for your prompt and excellent service! God Bless!

reviews.author: Deborah Hart-Serafini
reviews.text: They should get 10 stars! Great service, very knowledgeable and professional. They replaced tie rods on my Toyota Tacoma. Great work and fair prices. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Linda Machado
reviews.text: Ryan and his staff were extremely pleasant, professional, and a joy to work with - from escorting me back to my cabin while they worked on the car, to communications on progress, extra help, and a very reasonable charge! Highly recommend this fine group!

reviews.author: Debbie Patterson
reviews.text: If I could I would give them 10 stars!! These folks are amazing! My vehicle broke down on our way to the beach, the tow truck took us to Appalachian Automotive...thank you tow truck driver!! I had 2 grandchildren with me, which helped my anxiety to soar! I'm stuck, in a town with no rental cars, no Uber, no lyft, no way to get to Ashville to get a rental car and the rental car company wouldn't deliver to me. Ryan allowed an employee to take me 30 miles to get the rental car, while my husband and grandchildren waited in the air conditioned lobby with 2 darling little dogs. We continued on our trip to the beach and had a great vacation!! Ryan knew exactly what was wrong with my car and it's as good as new! Everyone was so very nice and I would recommend them all day, everyday!! Kudos to Appalachian Automotive!!

reviews.author: Dina Duffy
reviews.text: I'd like to give a big shout out to Ryan and his staff at Appalachian Automotive. It is a pleasure to work with them. The are extremely helpful, informative and they never try to upsell you on anything. In fact, they have offered great advice and "how to" information to help me prevent costly repairs. Their customer service is excellent and helps make the whole car repair servicing experience much easier than other places we have taken our car to. We highly recommend them for anyone who needs car servicing.

reviews.author: John Bett
reviews.text: Appal Automotive replaced two axle assemblies including brake drums, shoes due to leaking seals. The first set was slightly damaged during shipment and had a rub when installed. They replaced that set w/ another new set. It also had a slight rub/noise on wide turns. I decided to run it and see how annoying/frequent the noise would be. Concluded it was very intermittent and not worth chasing further. The entire repair took quite a bit longer but the staff at AA worked w/ the suppliers extensively to get the the required parts. Labor was extensive but I believe AA absorbed a significant amount of the overage. I brought the truck back a month later, they adjusted/bled the brakes. The overall job was a success.

reviews.author: Mark Licht
reviews.text: Ryan was right on spot with diagnosing our auto problem. We had a prompt perfect repair and the car now runs beautifully! The cost was very fair. Ryan and the many staff I met are great people.I highly recommend Appalachian Automotive!

reviews.author: Mercedes Letender
reviews.text: Very happy with the work done on my '13 focus. Cost came in just under original quote!Turnaround time was estimated half a day-they were done in an hour! Ryan was excellent in returning my calls and getting me scheduled quickly. It's been about 2 weeks since rotors were replaced and the work appears to be solid. No weird sounds or adjustments needed. Thanks so much guys!

reviews.author: Kirk Retz
reviews.text: Best auto repair shop ever! Smart. Honest. Skilled. Polite. I went to the dealership with a check engine light on and was quoted $3200 to fix it. A highly rated independent shop quoted $6500. Appalachian Automotive investigated and fixed my problem for about $300. I am a customer for life.

reviews.author: Go Places.
reviews.text: My son bought his first car after he worked two summers and earning money through good school grades and household chores. I wanted someone to give it a good safety check and once over so we would have a starting point. We planned on doing the majority of the work ourselves as a father son type deal. We were very happy with the thoroughness and transparency they provided. They even gave my son a few tips about the brakes. Best $$ we have spent. Well worth it and great company. We will be back.

reviews.author: Justin Proffitt
reviews.text: I have an 05 truck with electrical issues. They diagnosed it and had to send the cluster off for repair (couldn't be replaced because the part is not in production anymore). Got it back and it works like new. Great experience, great price! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tom Lanthorn
reviews.text: Ryan took us right in, diagnosed the problem, ordered the part and had us done in less than 24 hours. We were visiting from out of state. He was so helpful and courteous and made an upsetting time simple for us. Cant say enough about this place. Highly recommend!! Thank you Ryan!!

reviews.author: Renee Lenz
reviews.text: Needed an inspection. Happily they were able to provide that for us without much trouble. Looking forward to having them do some work in the vehicle next. They appear organized, knowledgeable and customer care oriented. Yeah!!

reviews.author: Abby Lee
reviews.text: Ryan was so kind to take care of my daughter's car! It was quick, affordable & we are so grateful that he was able to fit us in!! Communication with him & his team are top notch! I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Don Ellington
reviews.text: These folks provide top notch service to your vehicle with first class concern and communication. Upon arrival with my disabled Escalade the owner greeted me with a true concern for my dilemma and proceeded with multi point inspections. He was well versed in options that he explained and gave me a true feeling of being at the right place. I rested in their very nice customer waiting area with large screen TV set to a channel of my choice along with fresh coffee. This was a most pleasant experience and I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Ashley Watamura
reviews.text: I’ve been looking for a good mechanic and I feel like I found the best one. We got fast service and the cost was very reasonable. Sometimes I wonder if I’m getting taken advantage of at mechanics and dealerships but with App Auto I knew I wasn’t! Having your car break down sucks but they made it a great experience!

reviews.author: Manoneemus
reviews.text: Car butchers! Asked them to replace a timing belt and other associated maintenance parts on a Toyota with around 100k miles on it. The car was brand new for almost $30,000 when I bought it. There were no problems, and the engine ran soo smooth you couldnt even tell when it was idling. I have always changed the oil myself with synthetic oil and Toyota OEM filters. Purchased and gave them all Toyota OEM parts for the job. Printed out all the timing belt kit directions from the OEM Toyota service manual. Surprise, they still did not do it right! When I picked up the car, the engine started making horrible loud clacking sounds! I started recording the engine sound on video. They dumped in engine treatment, thinking it's going to quiet the noise without repairing serious engine damage on a V6 interference engine. I've done plenty of timing belts and already knew the belt wasn't installed properly and and the valves hit the pistons from the clunking sound the engine was making. I had to leave my car there another 2 weeks for them to fix the car. When it was ready for pickup, I asked what the problem was. How they fixed it. They said they didn't have an answer, and they said its just fixed! How shady is that?!! I had no choice and needed my car for work and hoped for the best. The engine ran ok but, has never sounded the same again and seems out of balance and shakes during cold start. Also here were 70 miles added to my car when I picked it up. Who is driving my car around? If you really plan on taking your car here for engine work, make sure you record it running before and after. Also, make sure you retain a lawyer!

reviews.author: GHOST HK
reviews.text: Ryan and his crew have done good work on my repairs. They did a complete engine swap on my 2005 Ford F150. Everyone has been courteous and professional. This is the only place I trust my vehicles with. Nice waiting area. Thanks!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Maier
reviews.text: The BEST shop I've ever been to!! Ryan is a terrific manager & a genuine, great person! You can see & feel the pride in their work & shop. I'm treated with respect & feel I'm listened to & that my time is valuable too. The work is done faster than anywhere else I've taken a vehicle! And it's done right, problems are fixed!! Prices are very reasonable & the waiting area is clean, comfortable, spacious!! I wish I found them sooner! You won't find a better shop anywhere!!

reviews.author: Ann Mims
reviews.text: Best experience ever! Just moved to Waynesville and took my car in for regular maintenance. The check engine light had been on for 5 years and 4 other mechanics could not figure out why. It was taken to 2 Chevy dealers in SC, and 2 highly recommended mechanics also in SC. They replaced parts, but the light never went off. I took it too Appalachian Automotive for and oil change and general maintenance and they found the problem immediately. They are knowledgeable, honest and don’t just rush your car through. I am so lucky to have found them.

reviews.author: Drew Mo
reviews.text: Joel’s service and phone manner are excellent. In a world where a lot of these places sound like they’re doing you a favor it’s refreshing to find sincere service. Been doing business w them for 13 yrs. They’re pretty booked so allow some lead time. Thanks.

reviews.author: Samuel Moseley
reviews.text: Ryan and Cody are phenomenal. on several occasions I've presented them with cars that no ordinary shop would even have the tools for, but they've handled every job timely, perfectly and reasonably from a cost perspective. can't recommend them enough, especially if own od-ball cars.

reviews.author: Jan h
reviews.text: The person I dealt with was Ryan and he was fantastic! He kept in contact with me - he was courteous in a world were we don't often get courtesy anymore. He explained things patiently taking photos as well. I have never had an auto mechanic do that. I would highly recommend appalachian auto.

reviews.author: Michael Bednarz
reviews.text: As first time customers and new to the area, Appalachian Auto was highly recommended by neighbors. We were so pleased (and relieved) to have a 5 star experience- patient, honest, friendly, expertise, fair and accurate pricing, and punctual service. AA has earned our repeat business for both cars

reviews.author: David Floyd
reviews.text: They were able to work us in even with a full shop. Provided the most thorough diagnostic service same day I took it in. Came in under the original estimate and work performed as promised. Appalachian Automotive was highly recommended to us and they fully lived up to their reputation. They’ll be getting all of my automotive work from here on out.

reviews.author: Richard Schaffer
reviews.text: I had an outstanding experience at Appalachain Automotive. Ryan and his team pay close attention to detail, are very honest and extremely thorough. I really appreciate how they interact with their customers and how much they care. I'll bring my 2008 335i back for service there any time. Thanks for the great service!

reviews.author: Traci Brinson
reviews.text: I’ve had my car worked on by Ryan and his staff a handful of times. He is always respectful, professional and fair on price/estimates. You have to schedule ahead for repairs and sometimes they can’t complete the job as quickly as I want/need it, but that’s because they are usually booked up for 2-3 weeks and busy because a lot of customers like them and their work. For me this is an small inconvenience because I have trouble finding a ride to work and such. But in all actuality I trust them and would rather wait on my car for good, quality work rather than to deal with some questionable work and have to have it redone. Ryan’s shop is not supposed to be open on weekends, but the week I brought my car in Ryan said he was down two mechanics and would keep working on all the cars they had in the lot throughout the weekend. He finished working on my car and came in slightly lower than the estimate.I recommend his shop as a friendly, professional, reputable shop even though they are busy all the time. He usually doesn’t quote unnecessary work either. I’m happy with the service I have had on my car over the years .If you want a respectful, knowledgeable mechanic Appalacian Auto is always the best choice.

reviews.author: Evan Stamper
reviews.text: Took my vehicle over for some suspension work (ride height adjustment). Shop was extremely busy but they still took the time to look at my car and discuss the best and quickest solution. Very knowledgeable, patient, and all around helpful staff. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Michael Scheidler
reviews.text: Great friendly service. Needed new brakes during vacation. They squeezed me in their busy schedule. Had 2 young kids with me and the waiting room was perfect. Pinball machine and big TV made the wait not too painful. Would highly recommend to anyone in need of car repair. Saved us from missing a day of hiking. Thanks again!

reviews.author: taylor kayal (glamtaylaaa)
reviews.text: This is the best auto repair shop in Haywood county! They provide the best service, with the best prices and customer service around! You will not be disappointed when you come here. They have worked on more than 3 vehicles for us and I can’t tell you how many in our family. Quality job every time

reviews.author: Guitar One
reviews.text: Office staff and technicians were courteous and professional in appearance and manner. They got me in quickly for a state inspection on my car. I will be back.

reviews.author: Bonnie Refinski
reviews.text: Everyone at Appalachian Auto was professional and helpful. Sierra handled my appointment efficiently and could answer all questions about my car’s service. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Jason Moore
reviews.text: Found Appalachian Automotive listed as a recommended installer for a transmission service I was using. When I called I was immediately impressed with how polite and well-spoken the person was and how quickly and easily he was able give me a quote for what I needed. I dropped off the car that afternoon and was given a time frame to have the work completed. The prices were good and considerably cheaper than what I had been quoted by other mechanics. The work was done quickly, professionally, And exactly as I was quoted. They did find one other issue that needed to be taken care of and contacted me to inform me of my choices and if I would like for them to fix it it while it was there. With as hard as it is to find a good honest mechanic nowadays I was extraordinary happy with my experience here and plan on using them in the future for any job big or small.

reviews.author: Eric Caskey
reviews.text: Blew a trans cooler line on I-40, Ryan's shop came up first on Geico's tow list, and had good reviews, but you never know! Turns out they are well deserved, these guys were ASE certified and very professional, no greasy t-shirts here. Long story short, I am very happy with their service and would recommend them to anyone. If I lived nearby they would be my go to auto shop. Eric

reviews.author: Jordan Barker
reviews.text: I made an appointment with Appalachian Automotive to have my front rotors assessed. The process was easy and on the day of the appointment, they were able to get my car in early. I ended up needing front brakes and rotors and they were able to change them same day and do everything within 1.5 hours. Great service and professionalism.

reviews.author: Michael Bailey
reviews.text: First of all I love cars and love keeping older ones on the road. A windstorm cracked the sunroof on my 1996 Toyota Avalon. Since its a pristine car with only 80K miles I wanted to have it fixed. Fortunately, I found a sunroof speciality company online and ordered the glass. I called, I suspect 20 places, many body shops and auto glass places and none of them would take the job. Then, Appalachian Automotive was recommended to us. We’re new to the area so we hadn’t established a relationship with a shop. Ryan the owner was polite, knowledgeable and his communication was excellent. He delivered on the replacement in the promised time frame. And get this, he had his technician perform a gratis 25 point examination fo the vehicle. When I drove onto his lot I saw the United Nations of cars, vehicles from: the UK, Italy, Germany, Korea, Japan and Sweden. I also own a 42 year old British sports car. I asked Ryan if he was experienced with Triumphs. He quickly said “yes, I’ve worked on a number of them”. For me this is proof of a great shop! Broadly experienced, attention to detail and excellent work.

reviews.author: Nash Kalra
reviews.text: Ryan is very honest and upfront. Their shop can work on any car make or model. Very professional and timely. Ryan always delivers in terms of timeliness and accuracy. In my honest opinion he is the best Auto Technician in the entire Haywood County all the way from Canton up to Waynesville and beyond. He has a great team of ASE certified mechanics. No need to really look elsewhere or shop around....for any and all your automotive repair needs!!Hands down Appalachian Automotive is the #1 place. Thank you Ryan again for everything.

reviews.author: Teresa Free
reviews.text: One word sums up this business, and that is integrity. Ryan is so knowledgeable, and he put my mind at ease. I will always be so grateful for what they have done to help me. Thank you Appalachian Automotive!!! Thank you Ryan!!

reviews.author: Chris DeVito
reviews.text: They were awesome. I had some codes and lights come and go over the last month. I brought it in, they diagnosed my problem and sent me on my way.

reviews.author: Joel Caldwell
reviews.text: Ryan has the best shop around. He has always been fair and honest with me. I have taken several different cars to him he has always done excellent service for me. There is no one else that I would trust with my cars. I recommend that everyone should use him.

reviews.author: Rebecca Buckner
reviews.text: Very knowledgeable of their products & services! Friendly staff! Not a try to get you in & out as fast as they can, but willing to take the time to do it right. Also, the website they sent to track the upkeep & repairs on my car is astonishing. First mechanic that I can say I am willing to go back to! Thanks Cierra & Ryan for going above & beyond!

reviews.author: Catherine Lennox
reviews.text: Ryan said, that he would get the part that was needed in 4 days. Job accomplished! Prior to Ryan The Mercedes was at 2 other locations for multiple months and they could not get the part that was needed to repair the car. Ryan accomplished this 2 different times! We are now bringing all the Mercedes to him. It is refreshing when people do what they say. Ryan also gets 5 stars for communication. Thank You for Your Professionalism. CL

reviews.author: Ruffhandz Nopolish
reviews.text: I appreciate Ryan’s honesty. I had a vehicle problem that developed over 24 hours and had to drop it in his lot before they opened as I was leaving town for a wedding. He texted that he was fully scheduled for the next 2 weeks to which I replied that I understood. This was Thursday. By Monday the crew had found the problem and by Tuesday noon I was back on the road. I had fully expected that I’d just have to pick up the vehicle and take it elsewhere...I get it... there’s a queue- you wait your turn. I appreciated so very much their diagnosis and determination that it was a fairly quick fix and that they could work it in. It’s a clean shop and clean operation. Very specific detailed receipts and the same for quotes. I’m a loyal customer.

reviews.author: Mark S
reviews.text: Many people tell me this place does great work. I guess I will never know. I waited 2 months to get in to get seen about some issues. They diagnosed the problems and found more, but I couldn't afford all of it all at once. They then told me I'd have to wait ANOTHER 2 months to get the first problem fixed.... Right. I'm sure I would have been seen right away had I been able to pay them to do it all right away. Ridiculous.

reviews.author: Badger Ski
reviews.text: We left home for a weekend trip to Kentucky when our serpentine belt broke. I called Appalachian Automotive and Ryan said bring it in. He determined they could get the work done immediately, got the parts in and sent us down the road. While at the shop I observed Ryan handle several customers. He treated everyone with respect and concern. At least one other walk-in. Composed young man who leads his business well. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jennifer Helvenston
reviews.text: I would highly recommend appalacian automotive to any one in need of a skilled honest mechanic. Ryan and his team went above and beyond both times I worked with them. We were able to do a contactless dropoff/pick up and payment. The repairs on my Subaru were done perfectly and at a great price without any complications. I experienced excellent customer service and I will be returning to them for all my automotive needs. Thank you again Ryan for such a wonderful experience in a difficult time!

reviews.author: David Moyer
reviews.text: We were on vacation in Maggue Valley and started having significant trouble with our brakes. We took a chance and stopped into Appalachian Automotive. The young man who was the owner said "We are booked up for a month or so but since you are on vacation, I will work you in". The mechanic got the car right away, took it into the shop, fixed it and we were on our way. Also the waiting area was spotless and very comfortable. I would highly recommend this business not only for the great quality of work but for their excellent customer service.

reviews.author: Jason Bugg
reviews.text: Ryan is a great dude. Needed work done on my niece's car and sent it to him based solely upon reviews. Took care of the work that needed to be done and did it at a fair price. I live out of the area, but if I ever found myself in Waynesville and needing auto repair work done Ryan and Appalachian Automotive would be the first place that I took my car.

reviews.author: Lindsey Meyers
reviews.text: Very friendly, honest people. They got me in quickly even with a lot full of cars. I thought I may need to replace my alternator and/or battery but ended up only needing to replace the belts. The repair cost was much cheaper than I expected. I appreciated their honesty and quick service. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Eric Amyot
reviews.text: These guys fixed up my Land Rover like they could have done it blindfolded and with one hand tied behind their back. Yeah, I recommend them! As a matter of fact, not only are they courteous, skilled, professional and knowledgeable, they are also super friendly. I'd come back here just to hang out and chat about what's going on in the world. Ever want a mechanic that could also be your very good friend and fix your car? If so, check them out. Disclaimer: Appalachian Automotive may or may not be looking for new friends. Time speaking with your mechanic about global events may detract from time spent working on your vehicle.

reviews.author: Steven Bordelon
reviews.text: This is where you should go for all auto repair. Honest, competent, friendly. I’m from out of state, and was in an urgent and desperate situation. Car needed repair on a late Fri afternoon, and I needed to leave town Sunday. Ryan and his team diagnosed the problem in 5 minutes. Ryan repaired my car at expense to his own time. He went above and beyond. I will always be grateful. Good man.

reviews.author: Mike Buchanan
reviews.text: I took my wife's Acura to Appalachian Auto Service with a bad starter. They were booked out a couple of weeks, but Ryan worked us in and we had a new starter with a life time warranty installed in just a few days. Quick turn around at a fair price and friendly service. A winning combination.

reviews.author: Jenna LeVan
reviews.text: Highly recommend! I've brought my car in for several repairs since moving to Waynesville. Always friendly, professional, and quality service that I trust. My boyfriend had an appointment with them and they pre-ordered the parts for him. A day before his appt my clutch failed, and AAO were kind enough to take my car instead and hold off on his. They replaced the clutch, battery, and sealed off a leaky transmission (and then added on a free oil change!). My car has never driven so smoothly - it feels like new. Very happy to have found a quality auto repair shop that I trust and know will be there for me. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Michael Snider
reviews.text: Absolutely above and beyond . Ryan and his team at Appalachian Automotive provided myself and my family with the most professional and compassionate service I could ever have asked for . After taking my family on a four day vacation to Cherokee we were returning home on our eight hour trip back to Yorktown Virginia when our van broke down less and hour into our return trip . Ryan went above and beyond to have our van repaired within 24 hours . Honestly I have grown up all over the world and I have met some very amazing people . I am truly blessed to have met Ryan. Thank you for everything

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Nelson
reviews.text: Finding a reliable, trustworthy and fair mechanic is one of the most challenging things. But I’m so happy to know that I have my go to place in town. Appalachian Automotive truly goes above and beyond for their customers - wether it’s squeezing you in their busy schedule, answering questions thoroughly or finding the best deal on parts. Ryan and his team are the only place I feel confident taking my cars to. Thanks!!!

reviews.author: Stanley Grabiec
reviews.text: Very impressed with Appalachian Automotive. They did a timely brake job for a reasonable price. Ryan knows his stuff and is easy and professional to deal with. Thanks for a great job!

reviews.author: Billy Schaaf
reviews.text: Appalachian Automotive was very professional and cared for my car as I would. They are very knowledgeable and kind, taking the time to explain things and show the parts on the vehicle in person. Very trustworthy and honest.

reviews.author: River Georgeff
reviews.text: Took my 2003 bimmer for an alignment. They did a 24 point inspection & texted me a detailed profile of my car that showed me everything I needed to know about it’s health on top of the alignment itself! Got her back right on time & Ryan was very polite & professional. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: ashley griffey
reviews.text: BEST mechanics I have met in a long time. Our radiator busted 10 hours from home and they had it fixed that day. They made us feel at home. I highly recommend them. Fast service and great personalities.

reviews.author: daniel skidds
reviews.text: They did a great job at a great price. I had a fuel leak on my Duramax. I am traveling in my Rv staying for 6 nights. Ryan helped me find the part and go my truck within a day. Brought on Monday afternoon received a call it was good to go Wednesday morning early. Its stressful traveling and then having a serious repair with a date to leave. They made it happen on time and correctly without any issues. All I can say is thank you.

reviews.author: Jamie Combs
reviews.text: Ryan and his team are great! They answered all of my many questions and treated me like I matter. They went above and beyond, even when it did not necessarily benefit them. I found them honest and a breath of fresh air when dealing with auto repair shops. They've earned my loyalty and business.

reviews.author: Moxxie Marketing and Magazine
reviews.text: Ryan, the owner is absolutely spot on. I called him over the phone with a situation and within minutes he was texting me asking me questions about my issue so he could further diagnose my problem before bringing my SUV to him. He was 100% on par, complete gentlemen and professional. He diagnosed my issue and is in the process of fixing for me. He even gave me advice on other ways to save money by purchasing the part myself versus going through the manufacturer. He saved me well over $100. Love this place. They have me for life!

reviews.author: Sara Brinkley
reviews.text: Ryan was awesome. Took my car, that wasn't drivable, and even though very busy, got my car back to me in just a few days. I will use him for all of my future vehicle needs. He sat down with me and went over each problem and explained what needed to be done.

reviews.author: David Marcus
reviews.text: Best shop in town. Honest, friendly Svc. Cody and Matthew are great mechanics. Shop and waiting area and restroom are always clean and there is always coffee. Guess I should mention Ryan. Excellent mechanic and runs a tight ship. Very personable. Wouldn't think of going anyway else

reviews.author: Carla Schmidt
reviews.text: Ryan the owner was Great! Honest about time, caring and polite. The shop was able to multi task on my car to bring prices down and to do many needed fixes while working efficiently. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Elijah King
reviews.text: To be honest, I've known the owner for over 15 years because we shared an interest and fondness for the RX-7 (Wankel Rotary). I knew then after talking to him about possible parts access and some cars he owned at the time that 1. He would embellish to make himself or his cars seem more profound. 2. His arrogance was offensive and he didn't mind being dismissive. With that said, he owns and operates a very successful business. There are a ton of customers that are satisfied with there work. In fact, he is overwhelmed with work and has to turn people down. The reason for my rating is this.. A friend of mine had to have there vehicle fixed, and as most shops do they checked alot of other things in the process. One of the most glaring problems was ignored and avoided it seems, while other things NOT as important we're both addressed, vastly over repaired and not discussed with the owner beforehand. Liberties we're taking with parts and labor that simply were not necessary and jumped the cost of the total job by nearly double. Extra fluid costs, flushes, parts, and labor were added to charges. I have many years of both parts sales and automotive maintenance and repair. Not having a place or time to fix there vehicle resulted in having Appalachian do the repairs. I'm sure that the vehicle is fixed and there will not be issues, but after spending $4,000, I was disappointed to see a puddle of fluid in the driveway 30 seconds after returning home. Instead of using and charging for 6 units of brake cleaner and engine degreaser that were charged for, that totaled $36.00, the source could have been fixed for less. Alot of his customers have BMW, Mercedes, and other top shelf marques for him to work on. So, they likely have more disposable income than most and probably wouldn't flinch when presented with a exceedingly expensive bill. But most of us just want it fixed and not have to take a loan out because everything was replaced instead of just what the problem was. Also, there are 900 miles that are unaccounted for on the odometer. If it were 9 miles, I would say "good job" they run it up the road to insure everything functioned properly. 904 miles seems like it may have been someone's way home for a few weeks. Just saying

reviews.author: Brandon Herndon
reviews.text: Trusted, good work. Veteran owned. Also specialize in Subaru. Ryan (owner) explained everything they needed to figure out and took time to show me under the hood as well. Will bring all our vehicles here.

reviews.author: Sean Elders
reviews.text: Ryan is a lifesaver. We were having problems with our transmission the day before Thanksgiving. Ryan opened up the shop the day after when they were technically closed to fix the problem, and set us on course for driving back to Florida 13 hours the following day. Our family is so grateful. Ryan went above and beyond and is a stand up guy. Do your business here, because they treat you like family.

reviews.author: Joan Smith
reviews.text: As an single, female solo RVer I was fortunate to have found Appalachian Automotive when one of my alternators died. I pulled into the shop parking lot in my motorhome and from start to finish (the job was done in less than an hour) I was treated with kindness and respect. Very professional and they went out of their way in searching for an alternator and installing it without my having to wait in line since I had a long drive ahead of me. I highly recommend this business!

reviews.author: Sandi S
reviews.text: Headlight replacement and tire rotation. After looking at YouTube and realizing that it was a bigger job than I anticipated, I asked AA to do the headlight replacement. Once there I added tire rotation. Jobs were completed. They are extremely courteous and thorough. I will be back for some bigger jobs such as brakes, belt replacement etc. Thank you.

reviews.author: Matthew Kimbrell
reviews.text: They were able to diagnose and fix my vehicle on the same day that it was dropped off on a busy Holiday week. They were nice, professional, and very reasonably priced. I would highly recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Krispy Kreme
reviews.text: Excellent shop. Top notch professional. Great communications. Expert mechanic. And a bmw expert! Ryan really helped us out. Not the cheapest in W Carolina but more than worth the slightly higher for the professionalism and quality.

reviews.author: Kathleen O'Connor
reviews.text: Ryan accepted my dead 18 year old auto the day I called even though I was not a regular customer. He called me with the problem and we went over price and time details. I did my homework online and was very surprised with his fair charges... and fast work. And, such a gentleman ! Although this shop is 18 miles away, I am now a devoted customer.

reviews.author: Catherine Jones
reviews.text: The representative explained that the earliest available appointment was beginning of August. She could tell by my voice I was concerned. I explained that I had to get inspection by end July and also wanted to have an oil change. She made an extra effort to get my car into their place on July 29. They also check other parts of my car besides the oil change and made notes of what other repairs were needed. Good people! Thank you

reviews.author: Emily Wooton
reviews.text: I was turned away by FOUR garages today for a simple headlight change on a VW Beetle (because the mechanics either didn’t know how to do it or refuse to because you have to remove the headlight)... I called and even though it was getting late in the day on the Friday before Christmas, Ryan got me in immediately and got the job done in no time. They are extremely welcoming and the lobby is more like a cozy living room than a lobby. They saved me today and I will be back. A knowledgeable mechanic with a friendly attitude makes all the difference!

reviews.author: Heinz brisske
reviews.text: Prompt, friendly service by someone who really knows his stuff. I would trust Ryan with about any service or repair item for my 1995 BMW or, for that matter, with my 2021 BMW. I’ve dealt with a number of good mechanics across the country, but Ryan tops them all.

reviews.author: Christopher Strader
reviews.text: Already knew vehicle was leaking oil and that the vehicle needed an alignment. Dealership wanted a significant and unreasonable amount to just clean and look for the leak. Appalachian Auto crew are professional, polite, respectful. They completed my oil change and cabin air filter change quickly. Confirmed for me there was an oil leak and cleaned the area and performed the necessary maintenance to identify the problem all without over charging, like the dealership was going to. All maintenance needed on my car will be done by this company and the crew that works there.

reviews.author: cali kornahrens
reviews.text: Amazing and humbling experience this morning at Appalachian Automotive! My husband, myself, our son and 2 dogs were leaving our awesome vacation here in Maggie Valley to head home to Charleston SC and woke up to a flat tire. We luckily stumbled upon this awesome repair shop! Immediately we knew we would be in good hands due to the “police lives matter” sticker on the front door and the beyond welcoming and warming greeting that the owner himself met us with! After he set us up comfortably in the waiting area and treating our pups to organic dog treats, he had our vehicle in and out of there in less than 30 mins! I would recommend this shop to any and everyone in need of servicing for their automobiles! Thank you for your services Appalachian Auto!!

reviews.author: David Baird
reviews.text: In Waynesville from out of town and developed a radiator problem (bad leak) and had a fairly urgent need for my car. The folks there could not have been nicer or more understanding. Got the new radiator and popped it in. I was back on the road in about 1 1/2 hrs. Great, great service.

reviews.author: vixxie
reviews.text: I will start by saying that the owner, Ryan, is a good guy to bring your vehicle to. He’s friendly, takes good care of you, male or female. I considered Ryan a friend, but I guess he didn’t consider us friends of his. My past experience with him & his shop have left my husband & I in a bad position. We don’t live in town, but we always brought our vehicle issues to Ryan. My husband dropped his 2011 Toyota Tundra off with Ryan back in December for an alignment. They kept his truck 3 days because they were backed up (no biggie). We get a call saying the front strut on truck was blown. We come take a look , & notice scuffs & scratches all over the truck. Ryan puts it on a lift to show us the under side of truck, dirt/mud, grass, was shoved inside & behind the bumper like the truck had bottomed out (this truck never goes off road) MORE scuffs & scrapes. We call our insurance....an adjuster comes to take a look...she wants to tow it to a different shop....This different shop owner blows our mind.... he shows us broken control arms, broken sway bar, twisted frame, busted fire wall welding.... this truck is TOTALED. Why didn’t Ryan show us all of that damage while we were standing under the truck in HIS shop? My husbands speaker box in the back seat was all the way against the door , sitting in an entirely new position (they are pretty heavy). What the hell happened to this Toyota Tundra?? A truck that was dropped off in perfect condition is now totaled 3 days later??? The second shop owner said there was NO way we could’ve driven this truck in this condition down our steep mountain driveway, then drive 25 miles to Ryan’s shop. Nobody at Ryan’s shop knows what happened to the tundra. Nobody is taking the blame or confessing anything! After posting our story on social media, we’ve had tons of people writing us with horror stories about APPALACHIAN AUTOMOTIVE. How the employees take joy rides in the costumers cars, doing donuts & burn outs in them, VEHICLES FALLING OFF OF THE LIFT. If you have a brain, do NOT bring your vehicle to Ryan & his employees.

reviews.author: Alex Bacon
reviews.text: I brought in a car with a plethora of issues and things needing to be fixed. They did a great job, kept me informed along the way and were very professional and friendly. Only place I’ll use to work on my cars from now on. They’re worth the wait!! Thanks

reviews.author: Doug Parham
reviews.text: The folks are very friendly and customer oriented. The service was thorough and completer as scheduled. I will definitely be back in the future.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Ellington
reviews.text: Highly recommend Ryan and his crew of mechanics. Any problem I have with all 3 of my vehicles I don't hesitate to call Appalachian automotive. Fast and friendly service all of the time.

reviews.author: Kelli Mitchell
reviews.text: Best car repair shop experience ever! They got me an appointment super quick. The car was ready when they said it would be. And they were 100% right with all their diagnostics! Definitely using Appalachian Automotive for all my car care needs!

reviews.author: Barbie Q.
reviews.text: I am waiting for a text setting my next appointment. I am confident that they are competent and fair. If their popularity is any indicator of long term satisfaction it is apparent in the long wait times for an appointment. I am satisfied with their work.

reviews.author: Adan Vazquez
reviews.text: Broke down at Max Patch which is 2 hours away from home. The team at Appalachian Auto fixed our problem extremely quick and had us heading back home the same day. Extremely professional and knowledgeable. Hope they were closer to home. I would 10/10 recommend

reviews.author: Donna Weaver
reviews.text: Appalachian Auto is a A+ business. The owner, Ryan is extremely knowledgeable, professional and has the utmost manners. The office is like a den at home and so clean as is the garage. The mechanics are engaging and so professional.

reviews.author: Brett Baker
reviews.text: I had abnormal brake sounds. They were busy but I was told to bring it in for a safety inspection, if it was too unsafe to drive they would try to squeeze me in for repairs. Turned out to be a minor issue with normal wear and tear so an appointment was scheduled to fix it. Customer safety seems to be a high priority for them.

reviews.author: J Saxour
reviews.text: If I could give Appalachian Automotive 10 stars, I would! They were so helpful, friendly and prompt in looking at my minivan when we had a problem while on vacation in Maggie Valley! I called several other shops around, and no one else was willing to look at my car the same day until I talked to Appalachian Auto who said they would try to squeeze me in to at least look at my car! They were able to fix my minivan so we could continue our vacation with peace of mind that the van could make it home! Thank you, thank you, thank you!!!

reviews.author: Van Walker
reviews.text: I have a 1988 560SL and Ryan’s team went over it with a fine tooth comb, as requested. It runs and drives like when it was “New”! They replaced a number of things and were very fair. Some of the parts were not stocked any longer, and Ryan found them, and I could tell it wasn’t easy. I’ll not take my vehicles to anyone else, and will recommend Ryan and Appalachian Automotive to everyone! They are a FIVE STAR operation!

reviews.author: Joy Trebolo
reviews.text: Outstanding! Thrilled to have found them! Honest, timely, explained exactly what was wrong, what they needed to do, how long it would take and how much it would cost! It is so hard to handle car repairs as a older woman alone! They could not have been kinder and more patient! And they had it ready a day early!!! I will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Jeffrey Henderson
reviews.text: Ryan and his staff are all very knowledgeable mechanics. Their prices are as good or better than other places I have been to. If I have any other vehicle issues, I will definitely go back.

reviews.author: Linda Brown
reviews.text: After trying to deal with a very rude service agent at Volkswagen of Asheville & their totally “I don’t give a hoot what your situation is” attitude, Appalachain Automotive was recommended as the best & fairest foreign car mechanic in the area. Ryan got my car in as quickly as possible, fixed the problem for a very reasonable price & was totally polite. Just had to take it in again this week & had the same great service. I highly recommend Appalachain Automotive for your Volkswagen.

reviews.author: Luis Cerda Jr
reviews.text: My wife and I have been bringing our vehicles to Ryan at Appalachia Automotive since we move to WNC 3 years ago, and we won't take them anywhere else! We have never had such personal and attentive care from a mechanic. I can't recommend this place enough. Give them one chance and you will be thinking the same way too.

reviews.author: Michael Egelston
reviews.text: Good folks! Excellent service and easy to deal with. Repaired my classic with care and charged a fair price. Definitely will use Ryan's shop again.

reviews.author: Kris K
reviews.text: Ryan and his staff are the most professional mechanics we have had the pleasure of doing business with in WNC. They offer highly skilled work completed at reasonable prices. Unlike some other auto repair facilities in the area, Appalachian Automotive is oriented to meeting and exceeding the customer's needs and expectations.

reviews.author: Joseph Yurko
reviews.text: Ryan is very professional. He introduced Cody the tech who would diagnose the problem and do the repair. Everything was completed that afternoon. The 24 point review was a pleasant surprise. Very pleased with the whole experience.

reviews.author: Will Lehman
reviews.text: I've only gone once, for an oil change. I brought my own oil and filter and they only charged me $15! Now I'm embarrassed I ever went to Snappy Lube, where I've had some very iffy experiences. One thing, though: even for the oil change you have to book ahead. My appointment was two weeks out, but totally worth the wait!

reviews.author: Loye McCoy
reviews.text: Haven’t had time to determine the quality of work done. But, everyone at Appalachian Automotive was courteous; friendly and prompt with services rendered. I will certainly go back if needed.

reviews.author: Steven Rathbone
reviews.text: The owner (Ryan)goes out of his way to please his/her customer, fantastic customer service , and is staffed by certified Mechanics who are down to earth hard working people. Highly recommend if you're dealing with European vechiles. Honest and affordable.

reviews.author: Aaron Robinson
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience with Appalachian Automotive. Worked me in when I really needed some help. Felt like the price was fair and the service was great. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Joshua Daniel
reviews.text: These guys are awesome. I was passing through needed help diagnosing a problem. They spent time on the phone with me trying to figure it out.

reviews.author: Douglas “Duke” DeLano
reviews.text: App.Auto were great w/my 2013 Sbaru Outback. Owner, Ryan & assistant Courtney were very helpful; working out their work schedule to fit our needs. Quality work & great work means we'll be back, for sure!

reviews.author: Diana Calderon
reviews.text: As a seasonal resident of Waynesville, I have always been able to rely on Appalachian Motors. Ryan, the owner, runs a professional business, and is always polite and courteous. Most important: his mechanics do top notch work!

reviews.author: Jake Hepner
reviews.text: Very professional, they communicate well, and they work to take care of ems and those that give back to the community. I wish all businesses were run like Appalachian Auto!

reviews.author: Meagan Hilton
reviews.text: These guys and gals are a godsend. They have fair prices and will work with you to get your car fixed as quickly as possible within your budget. They squeezed me in to get a new water pump even though they were booked.

reviews.author: John Jameson
reviews.text: I took my car in and was told it would be done in 2 weeks. After 1 year they let me know that they could not fix my car that I could come get it and the price would be $800. several repairs were done without my knowledge. I will be taking them to small claims court. I highly recommend you take your car somewhere else

reviews.author: Mandy #lilblacksheep
reviews.text: I needed a local mechanic experience with BMW’s that could service and diagnose my vehicle, as well as, install a new battery and program the car accordingly. Though, Ryan didn’t have an appointment until almost 4 weeks later... he fit my 1hr. job in on his day closed (Saturday).

reviews.author: Jenna Jones
reviews.text: Ryan and his crew always take care of me! They are wonderful to work with and are a truly affordable and trustworthy option here in Haywood County. I recommend them to everyone!

reviews.author: Matt Ferrari
reviews.text: I came in for an alignment for my Mini, the team was knowledgeable, professional, courteous. Ryan went out of his way and fit me in on.

reviews.author: Bethany Buchanan
reviews.text: Appalachian Automotive is the best mechanic I’ve ever been to. They are honest, thorough, and affordable plus the employees are so nice!

reviews.author: Justin Davis
reviews.text: If you own an imported vehicle, you want to bring it here. These guys know their stuff. They have top of the line tools that go along with their top of the line know how. Got a problem with a domestic vehicle, they are geniuses with those too. They also have an extremely comfortable waiting room.

reviews.author: Sam
reviews.text: Extremely kind and honest. They always explained everything with my vehicle so thoughtfully and were so thorough in their repair/diagnostics of my vehicle. I couldn’t have more gratitude to find such an amazing mechanic.

reviews.author: Bill Faust
reviews.text: I am a first-time customer. Everyone so welcoming and professional. Explained everything before beginning work. Came in under quote. Didn't try to sell me anything my vehicle didn't need. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Susan Wommack
reviews.text: Appalachian Automotive saved the day! We developed a diesel leak in our truck on vacation and they took care of us quickly, very well, and at a great price. Thank you!

reviews.author: Kay Harris
reviews.text: We hit a bear! They examined our car to make sure it was ok for us to drive our car home. We live in another state. Took their time. Checked it very carefully! Removed pieces that were dragging! Didn’t even want to charge me! Couldn’t have been better service. Can’t recommend enough!

reviews.author: Mary Runyan
reviews.text: I am so grateful for Ryan and his group of mechanics. They do awesome work and I trust their opinion. They were super busy but managed to work me in Monday.

reviews.author: Dale Knight
reviews.text: Up here for vacation. Had problems with the brakes. Ryan was able to fit me in to his busy schedule. Got every thing done on time and at a fair price. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Rick Queen
reviews.text: Great experience. He was very busy, but made time. Also, found another issue that was the actual true problem, not what I initially thought. As good or better than the Asheville import mechanics I had been using.

reviews.author: Jenn Jones
reviews.text: Ryan and his crew are AWESOME. I trust them completely and am grateful to have found them. Me and my Subaru won't be going anywhere else.

reviews.author: Kristen Barton
reviews.text: Stopped in for an inspection around 11:30am. They got it done quickly and I was on my way in time to meet my husband for lunch

reviews.author: Amanda Huertas Revis
reviews.text: Love it here, I won't bring my car anywhere else. Ryan and his employees are so friendly and honest and the prices are so fair. My husband and I both bring our vehicles here for everything we need that we can't do ourselves.

reviews.author: Kym Barker
reviews.text: I went to Appalachian auto service on Russ Avenue in Waynesville and they corrected the problem Apple Tree Honda quoted for 1600 for $11.87. Ryan is awesome! Go see him.

reviews.author: Lloyd Lippert
reviews.text: Ryan's is the most honest, respectable person I've ever met. He's always been fair and forthright. I won't use anyone else to take care of my car.

reviews.author: Trac M (TracM-KW)
reviews.text: Very thorough PPI. Gave me great info regarding car I was considering purchasing. Very pleasant and worked me in quickly. Thank you

reviews.author: dave barone
reviews.text: Great service received from the time I received the quote through vehicle drop off and service completion. The process was seamless and the staff was very helpful and courteous. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Christopher Friday
reviews.text: First time customer and could not be happier. The entire team was great at communication and got the job done sooner than I expected. Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Vickie Helbing
reviews.text: Excellent service, a job well done. I rarely give five stars in a review, but this was definitely a five star experience.

reviews.author: Ann Hall
reviews.text: Extremely nice. Made sure I understood exactly what they were doing. They showed me my worn out break pads and gave me pointers on how I can make my new breaks last longer.

reviews.author: Reggie Gilmore
reviews.text: The team of support is incredible! They are knowledgeable with a focus on customer support. Forget the dealership. These guys are the real deal. ........oh, did I say their rates are very reasonable?

reviews.author: Sandy Beckwith
reviews.text: Very responsive about getting us right in and quickly diagnosed the issue. Repaired at reasonable cost and got us on our way!

reviews.author: Betty Durham
reviews.text: I would recommend Appalachian Automotive to anyone. They go above and beyond for their customers. So nice, knowledgeable and professional. I can’t thank them enough.

reviews.author: Jane Seals
reviews.text: Everyone was very friendly & helpful. They fit me in at the last minute, which was extra kind. They definitely have my business from now on!

reviews.author: Rachel Carter
reviews.text: Had an awesome experience! They really worked with me to make sure they could work on my car for the best price possible and they communicated with me to make sure I knew what was going on in the process.

reviews.author: Garnet Oltmann
reviews.text: Awesome business. They know what they are doing. Had a 3:00 appt for oil change. Left at 4:00. NO CHARGE as was told I had to wait too long. They are my forever repaiy shop!!!

reviews.author: William Hutchings
reviews.text: I went based on a recommendation and from my one experience so far I believe they will do an honest assessment of your vehicle and only service what is needed. They seem like a business that values loyal customers.

reviews.author: Diana Campton
reviews.text: I was looking to purchase a used vehicle and they did an inspection for me. Ryan was extremely helpful. I would definitely recommend this place.

reviews.author: Jeff Baxter
reviews.text: This guy is very unprofessional. Got in my wife's face and yelled at her after she made an appt to get her car fixed, left it there all day for them to do absolutely nothing to it. Will will be going to Taylor Ford instead. It's not ok to get in a women's face and yell after you didn't keep your word. Go elsewhere.

reviews.author: Uriah Maney
reviews.text: Appalachain Auto delivered excellent customer service and superb performance and quality of work on our family 4x4 vehicle. Look no further, you've found the right place!

reviews.author: Kaitlin Kamakura
reviews.text: Fixed the shoddy work of a different mechanic with professionalism and a friendly attitude! Excellent price for the work.

reviews.author: Herman Oellerich
reviews.text: Have been dealing with Ryan for more than 7 years. The most honest person I've ever met. You can always trust him.

reviews.author: Joan Rhodes
reviews.text: Prompt, professional service. Reasonably priced and I liked the complementary 24 point inspection. Cierra was very helpful.

reviews.author: The Sandefurs
reviews.text: Honest and reasonable! Very knowledgeable and professional. We will be taking our cars back there again for any service needed.

reviews.author: Al Tagliaferro
reviews.text: They are always very professional and do excellent work. Unlike many places where you dread finding out what's wrong, I don't ever worry about being charged for repairs I don't need.
